detections.mission_name: Payment Failure Rate by Region and Instrument with High Transaction Volume
detections.sql:
SELECT 
  le.country, 
  t.instrument, 
  COUNT(*) as txn_count, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failed_count, 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / txn_count) * 100 as failure_rate
FROM 
  users u 
  JOIN login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id 
  JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id
WHERE 
  UPPER(t.status) = 'FAILED' 
  AND t.created_at >= date('now', '-30 days')
GROUP BY 
  le.country, 
  t.instrument
HAVING 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / txn_count) * 100 > 10
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  u.user_id, 
  AVG(CASE WHEN t.instrument IN (SELECT instrument FROM transactions WHERE user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY instrument HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3) THEN t.amount_usd ELSE 0 END) as avg_volume
FROM 
  users u 
  JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id
WHERE 
  t.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')
GROUP BY 
  u.user_id
detections.recommendation: Try broadening your search criteria or checking if the data for this period is available.
detections.original_query: Analyze the payment failure rate (status='failed') grouped by region (extracted from country) and instrument, and identify if specific regions and instruments experience significantly higher failure rates ( > 10%) within the last 30 days, and have a standard deviation of transaction volume by instrument for each user where multiple instruments (>= 3) represent >20% of their total transaction volume_usd in the last quarter.

detections.mission_name: Users with Multiple Devices and High-Risk Instruments
detections.sql:
SELECT u.full_name 
FROM users u 
JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id 
JOIN (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT device_fingerprint) AS device_count, user_agent, 
  MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN created_at ELSE NULL END) AS failed_login_at, 
  MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN ip_address ELSE NULL END) AS failed_ip 
  FROM login_events 
  WHERE created_at >= date('now', '-2 hours') 
  GROUP BY user_id, device_fingerprint, user_agent 
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT device_fingerprint) >= 3
) le ON u.user_id = le.user_id 
WHERE UPPER(t.instrument) LIKE '%CRYPTO%' OR UPPER(t.instrument) LIKE '%FOREX%' 
AND u.risk_level IN ('MEDIUM', 'HIGH') 
AND u.user_id IN (
  SELECT user_id 
  FROM login_events 
  WHERE created_at >= date('now', '-60 days') 
  GROUP BY user_id 
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT device_fingerprint) >= 3
)

detections.mission_name: Payment Failure Rate by Instrument with High Standard Deviation
detections.sql:
SELECT 
  t.instrument, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS failure_rate
FROM 
  transactions t
WHERE 
  t.created_at >= date('now', '-30 days')
GROUP BY 
  t.instrument
HAVING 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) > 0.05;

SELECT 
  t.instrument, 
  AVG(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS avg_failure_rate
FROM 
  transactions t
WHERE 
  t.created_at >= date('now', '-30 days')
GROUP BY 
  t.instrument
HAVING 
  AVG(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0.05;

SELECT 
  u.user_id, 
  u.full_name, 
  GROUPING_SETS (
    SELECT 
      t.instrument, 
      SUM(t.amount_usd) AS total_usd
    FROM 
      transactions t
    WHERE 
      t.user_id = u.user_id AND 
      t.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')
    GROUP BY 
      u.user_id, 
      t.instrument
  ),
  GROUPING_SETS (
    SELECT 
      t.instrument, 
      COUNT(DISTINCT t.instrument) AS instrument_count
    FROM 
      transactions t
    WHERE 
      t.user_id = u.user_id AND 
      t.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')
    GROUP BY 
      u.user_id, 
      t.instrument
  )
FROM 
  users u
WHERE 
  u.user_id IN (
    SELECT 
      t.user_id
    FROM 
      transactions t
    GROUP BY 
      t.user_id
    HAVING 
      COUNT(DISTINCT t.instrument) >= 3 AND 
      SUM(CASE WHEN t.instrument IN (
        SELECT 
          t2.instrument
        FROM 
          transactions t2
        GROUP BY 
          t2.instrument
        HAVING 
          COUNT(DISTINCT t2.instrument) >= 3 AND 
          SUM(CASE WHEN t2.instrument IN (
            SELECT 
              t3.instrument
            FROM 
              transactions t3
            WHERE 
              t3.user_id = t2.user_id AND 
              t3.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')
            GROUP BY 
              t3.instrument
            HAVING 
              SUM(t3.amount_usd) / (
                SELECT 
                  SUM(t4.amount_usd)
                FROM 
                  transactions t4
                WHERE 
                  t4.user_id = t2.user_id AND 
                  t4.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')
              ) > 0.2
          ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) > 0.2
      ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) > 0.2
  );

detections.mission_name: High-Risk Exposure with Unusual Login Activity
detections.sql:
SELECT u.full_name 
FROM users u 
JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id 
JOIN login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id 
WHERE UPPER(t.amount_usd) > '100000' 
AND t.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days') 
AND (t.user_id IN (SELECT t2.user_id FROM transactions t2 GROUP BY t2.user_id HAVING COUNT(t2.txn_id) > 20) 
OR (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(t3.instrument) LIKE '%HIGH-RISK%' THEN t3.amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(t3.amount) * 100 
FROM transactions t3 
WHERE t3.user_id = u.user_id AND t3.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')) > 15) 
AND le.user_id IN (SELECT le2.user_id FROM login_events le2 GROUP BY le2.user_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN UPPER(le2.status) LIKE '%FAILED%' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) > 10) 
AND UPPER(u.risk_level) IN ('MEDIUM', 'HIGH');

detections.mission_name: Users with Decreased Transaction Volume and High-Risk Instrument Activity
detections.sql:
SELECT u.user_id, u.full_name, u.risk_level, u.risk_score, t.txn_type, t.instrument, t.amount_usd, t.created_at, t.processed_at 
FROM users u 
JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id 
JOIN login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id 
WHERE UPPER(t.instrument) LIKE '%CRYPTO%' OR UPPER(t.instrument) LIKE '%FOREX%' 
AND t.created_at >= date('now', '-60 days') 
AND t.created_at <= date('now', '-30 days') 
AND t.amount_usd > (SELECT AVG(t2.amount_usd) FROM transactions t2 WHERE t2.user_id = t.user_id AND t2.created_at >= date('now', '-60 days')) * 0.7 
AND u.risk_level IN ('MEDIUM', 'HIGH')
